description: This file contains the implementation of the IPTestAdministrator class, which manages inter-process communication and synchronization for unit tests involving child processes. It includes methods for process forking, synchronization via shared memory and condition variables, and process management functions.

classes.name: IPTestAdministrator
classes.description: A class that manages inter-process communication and synchronization for unit testing, including process forking, shared memory setup, and synchronization primitives.

methods.name: IPTestAdministrator::ForkChildProcess
methods.description: Creates a child process and sets up shared memory and synchronization primitives for communication.

methods.name: IPTestAdministrator::Sync
methods.description: Performs synchronization between parent and child processes using shared memory and condition variables.

methods.name: IPTestAdministrator::GetProcessName
methods.description: Returns a string indicating whether the current process is the parent or the child.

methods.name: IPTestAdministrator::TimedLock
methods.description: Attempts to lock a mutex with a timeout, aborting on timeout.

methods.name: IPTestAdministrator::TimedWait
methods.description: Waits on a condition variable with a timeout, aborting on timeout.

methods.name: IPTestAdministrator::FillTimeOut
methods.description: Fills a timespec structure with the current time plus the maximum wait time.
